spots.name: Providence Canyon State Park
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: McGraw Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 330 m (1,083 ft).

spots.name: Cascade Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.

spots.name: Viewpoint (396 m)
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing southeast. Good for sunrise. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
